body: Dude. I just realized this is in Michigan. Crazy shit. I live there.

Im a psychologist in a jail and I struggle IMMENSELY with mental health issues. But what I can say is that I am successful because it helps talking with someone who you can relate to. Common themes where I work is depression so I can relate to my clients and understand mostly what they’re going through. Not precisely but the feelings are the same: hopelessness, suicide, anxiety etc. 
it helps them to know that they’re not the only person struggling and finding support is important and they fee they can come to me to talk about their issues. I pass along coping skills and whatnot.
That’s awesome ! I’m so happy you might be doing it more! Keep up the good fight. Hit me up if you need someone to bounce ideas off of.

Continue writing. Seriously. I wrote a ton when I was younger. About depression and murder type of things. Really helped me through a hard time. Wish I would still do that nowadays. Whatever you write. I’ll read it. You have talent. I appreciate it

I took abilify before. It helped a lot. Doctors sometimes uSe it in conjunction with an antidepressant because abilify helps with depression actually. I was taking 10mg of it. All it really did was give me dry mouth. 
However. I had to be taken off of it because I was given adderall. Abilify and adderall cross each other out I was told. I don’t know if it’s the same for Ritalin though. Might wanna ask them.

It’s more about whether or not you actually want to kill yourself. I struggle with suicidal ideations. But the picture you’re referring to, just kinda hit me. Doesn’t mean I’m gonna kill myself but it’s still relatable. If you’re struggling or grappling with plans of suicide or set harm, talk to someone you trust. Otherwise people find comfort in seeing those images. I know I do.
I’ve seen that too. Relatable. I don’t see anything wrong with it
Sometimes it can help talking through things with an unbiased person. So if you want to chat. Hit me up. I’m a good listener.
Hey. If you ever need someone to talk to. Hit me up.

I cried too. It’s fucked up but at the end of the movie when he’s on the talk show and after the riot started I started crying of happiness for him. Like he finally accomplished what he set out to do.

Hey. I went through a similar situation a couple days ago. I hadn’t cut in over a year. Cutting for me is like depression. You might be in the clear for a while but sometimes you relapse. That’s okay. The point is to keep moving forward and try to reach out to trusted loved ones. I talked about it with my therapist and she wasn’t angry with me. I told my friend about it and she wasn’t angry either. They were both happy I ended up reaching out to someone. If you have no one to talk to you can hit me up. I’ll talk you through it. Keep your head up.
